This week, J and Ben finally receive their Hogwarts letters and are sent off to the Magic Academy! But what’s this? Mysterious creatures from another dimension have been unleashed throughout the school!? With their professors nowhere to be found, J and Ben become the Chosen One(s)! Watch them trudge through obstacle after obstacle, solving riddle after riddle. All in the name of defeating the nefarious “polterbolds” and saving the academy from total and utter destruction.
